test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides. A sits third to the right of C. H sits between B and G . F sits second to the right of C. D does not sit in a corner. G sits third to the right of D. Three people sit between D and C.

Who sits second to the left of B ?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H are sitting around a square table facing the center of the table.

1) D does not sit in a corner.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf319c2f2b319dc6a74ce341ae091baf4d8195f573669db3f2941d024596612c.png] 

2) G sits third to the right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5b07d83d91b99af1c38a87a86f29dbc85165cdc478cc0504c855993d9f7b475.png] 

3) Three people sit between D and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b22bcf2c7f5e48deba6c3048b1291075b23ba42271934cb5b4e019a1e6641af.png] 

4) F sits second to the right of C and A sits third to the right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f00282af11cd3ce6b70577487c13d91c4f0c37eb0071b80f4be2da33d6dfc9f.png] 

5) H sits between B and G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37a9f5ea4a5aad5fa91a565a18ccfbbd5032cfb24cb5a3269e7393ea55d740b4.png] 

So, E will sit in the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ce54e9df81aeb007d7d58f030e29ebb61796fe0c04944ec76b198168803f613.png] 

Here, 'A' is second to the left of B.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
